confirm.exit.body: The ones you don't save will come back as they were the last time they were saved, or won't come back if they were never saved.

settings.title: Settings
settings.general.saving_explanation: Saved tabs are reopened next time, even if the app closes unexpectedly. Without autosave, a tab with changes shows ● ; {save} saves it and {toggle} turns autosave on for that tab only, until the app is closed. When exiting, you are asked what to do with the tabs that have changes.
settings.general.updates_explanation: When a new version is published on GitHub, a small button appears next to the window controls. Nothing is downloaded until you accept.
settings.shortcuts.explanation: Click a combination and then press the new keys (Esc cancels).
shortcuts.error.already_used: That combination is already used by “{action}”.
shortcuts.error.needs_ctrl_or_alt: Use Ctrl or Alt in the combination (or an F1-F12 key).
ssh.intro: 1. Enable the SSH agent.  2. Create a key with a passphrase and add it to the agent.  3. Add your servers and install the key on them. After that you will log in without typing anything.
ssh.agent.explanation: Remembers your unlocked keys (encrypted with your Windows account) so you don't have to type the passphrase on every connection.
ssh.reload: Read the .ssh folder and the agent again
ssh.no_keys: You don't have any SSH key yet.
ssh.create_key_explanation: A tab opens where you type the passphrase (twice). If you lose it, the key is useless.
ssh.key.no_passphrase: No passphrase: anyone who copies the file can use it
ssh.key.not_in_agent: Not in the agent: you will be asked for the passphrase on every connection
ssh.no_servers: You haven't added any server yet.
ssh.install_key: Install the key (asks for the password once)
ssh.check: Check whether it logs in without asking anything
ssh.check.locked: The key is installed, but it still has to be added to the agent (you will be asked for the passphrase)
ssh.check.fails: Can't log in: the key isn't installed, or the server doesn't respond
ssh.explain.create_key: Type the passphrase of the new key (twice). Then come back to Settings.
ssh.explain.change_passphrase: Leave the current passphrase empty and type the new one (twice).
ssh.explain.add_to_agent: Type the passphrase once: the agent will remember it.
ssh.explain.install_key: Type the password of {server} in the new tab; it will be the last time.
ssh.error.unsafe_characters: Only letters, numbers and . _ - @ : are allowed
ssh.error.key_exists: You already have a key called {name}.
ssh.error.agent_not_installed: The SSH agent is not installed on this Windows.
ssh.error.agent_not_enabled: The agent was not enabled (was the administrator permission cancelled?).

support.explanation: If Console is useful to you, you can support its development. It is completely voluntary: the app is free for personal use and will stay free.

updates.error.checksum_mismatch: The download does not match the published checksum: it was not installed.

encryption.error.encrypt: Windows could not encrypt the settings.
encryption.error.decrypt: Could not decrypt the settings (do they belong to another user or computer?).
encryption.error.decrypt_with_password: Could not decrypt the data (it is damaged, or was saved with another password).
unlock.create.title: Create the password
unlock.create.explanation: This is the portable console: everything it saves (commands, tabs, settings, SSH servers) is kept next to the program and encrypted with this password, so you can take it to another computer. Use at least {count} characters. If you forget it, the data cannot be recovered.
unlock.open.title: Unlock the console
unlock.open.explanation: Type the password of this portable console.
unlock.error.does_not_match: The two passwords are not the same.
